description:
[Filings Oracle] Form 4 insider transactions parsed to one row per trade: insider, role and title, security, code (P purchase, S sale, A grant ...), shares, price, dollar value, shares owned after, direct/indirect, and whether it was under a 10b5-1 plan — Form 4 insider transactions parsed to one row per trade: insider, role and title, security, code (P purchase, S sale, A grant ...), shares, price, dollar value, shares owned after, direct/indirect, and whether it was under a 10b5-1 plan. Defaults to open-market buys and sells only.

**Example:** `/v1/insider-trades?side=buy&min_value=100000&exclude_10b5_1=true`

all_codes.description: Optional. true to include grants, option exercises, tax withholding and gifts (default false: open-market P and S only).

days.description: Optional. Look back N days (default 7, max 90). Ignored when since is set.

exclude_10b5_1.description: Optional. true to drop trades made under a pre-arranged 10b5-1 plan.

min_value.description: Optional. Minimum trade value in USD.

owner.description: Optional. Case-insensitive substring of the insider's name.

side.description: Optional. buy or sell (open-market purchases / sales).

since.description: Optional. Cursor from meta.cursor of a previous response.

wait.description: Optional. With since: long-poll up to N seconds (max 25).

name: filings_insider_trades
